name: V-Tech Studio Widgets for Elementor
author: vedsharma97

sections.description: Professional WordPress toolkit with advanced widgets for Elementor, forms, templates, and WooCommerce features. Includes customizable WooCommerce products grid and blog grid with category filtering, AJAX add-to-cart, badges, responsive design, and extensive style controls.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/v-tech-studio-widgets-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit a page with Elementor and add the “Ved Woo Products Grid Widget” or “Ved Blog Grid” widget.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

No, it works with the free version of Elementor.

What versions of Elementor are supported?

This plugin requires Elementor 3.0.0 or higher and has been tested up to Elementor 3.31.2.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

WooCommerce is only required for the Woo Products Grid widget.

Can I style the widgets for mobile and tablet?

Yes, all style controls are fully responsive.
